title: The nine-proof recap

members.role: the recap dock opens over a world that goes on cutting beneath it
the first already-shown proof flies in from depth on its own phrase and is held large at centre while it is spoken
the rail clears on the pivot line: the nine railed cards burst radially and the recap is over

does: Every proof of the argument re-enters as one object: each flies in on its own phrase, is held large while spoken, recedes to a rail spot, and the whole mosaic bursts on the pivot line 25 s later.
